fact: LISGIS published the 2023 Socioeconomic Statistical Bulletin (Vol. 4 No. 01, December 2023), compiled mainly from ministry, agency and commission administrative data (education, health, security, trade, transport and others), with most data covering 2016-2022.
The portal presents education statistics from the ministry's school and learner records for 2024-25; no other record-holder is named.
